name: Haldiram's Khatta Sweet and Salty mix
ingredients: Refined Rice Flakes (22%), Bengal Gram Flour (Besan) (21%/ Split Pulse Bengal Gram (Chana Dal) (7%), Groundnut (Peanuts) (5%), Sago (4%), Refined Sugar (4%), Red Lentils (Masur Whole) (2.5%), Green Peas (2%), Iodised Salt, Blac Red Chilli, Acidity Regulator & Antioxidant (E 330) and Turmeric. Allergy Advice : Contains Peanut May Contain Tree nuts, Gluten, Sesame Seed, Milk, Soya & Mustard Seed
